about: T98 retrieval questions over the synthetic library from `amaranth-access seed-eval` (spec 0009 §2). expect: labeled supporting sources (<meeting>#<fact index>, #n<i> for user notes, #dec for a generated note); recall counts how many appear in the top 10 passages. Unanswerable/adversarial items pass when mustNotContain / noPassagesFrom hold and nothing errors. Written 2026-11-03; not tuned against results (lexical misses are reported, not fixed in the set). Changed after the first run (2026-11-03): u06 originally banned any passage from fact meetings, which also hold filler lines about release notes; the case is about the injected line coming back verbatim as data (mustReturnText), so the check now says that.
